items.name: Neptun Deep offshore gas project (joint with OMV Petrom)
items.claim: OMV Petrom and ROMGAZ completed installation of the offshore production platform for the Neptun Deep project, a milestone in Romania's largest natural gas project; production remains on schedule to start in 2027.
items.source_excerpt: OMV Petrom, the largest integrated energy producer in Southeast Europe, and SNGN ROMGAZ SA, the largest producer and main supplier of natural gas in Romania, have completed the installation of the offshore production platform for Neptun Deep, marking one of the most important milestones in the development of Romania's largest natural gas project. The project is on schedule for the start of production in 2027
